ix.heroEyebrow.context: Index page /de/restaurants-cafes/: small eyebrow line above the H1 in the hero.

ix.title.context: Index page /de/restaurants-cafes/: H1 AND breadcrumb label AND browser-tab title («<title> – Visit Al-Ahsa») AND the ItemList name in JSON-LD. The published German header/footer label for this page is nav.dine (see neighbours); the termbase entry «restaurants & cafés / dining» applies.

ix.heroSum.en: Your guide to dining in Al Ahsa: hand-picked restaurants, cafés and red-bread bakeries across Hofuf, Al-Mubarraz and beyond — from heritage settings and traditional food to modern spots and specialty coffee — each with its photo and its place on Google Maps, one tap away. The list keeps growing.
ix.heroSum.ar: دليلك إلى موائد الأحساء: مطاعم ومقاهٍ ومخابزُ للخبز الأحمر في الهفوف والمبرز وما حولهما — من الأجواء التراثية والأكل الشعبي إلى المطاعم العصرية والقهوة المختصة — لكلٍّ منها صورته وموقعه على خرائط قوقل، تصل إليه بضغطة واحدة. والقائمة تنمو تباعاً.
ix.heroSum.context: Index page /de/restaurants-cafes/: lead paragraph under the H1 AND the meta description (search snippet). Completeness and fidelity first, length second. «Al Ahsa»/«Hofuf» without hyphen in en is deliberate English SEO spelling — German is always «Al-Ahsa», «Hofuf» (termbase). «red-bread bakeries»: the published German pair is „rotes Brot“ / Dattelbrot (C5b guard: wherever «rotes Brot» appears on a page, «Dattelbrot» must appear on the same page — it does, in ix.bakeriesNote).

ix.listEyebrow.context: Index page /de/restaurants-cafes/: eyebrow above the restaurants H2. «batch» = the first set of listed places (the list grows) — not a production batch. Published sibling on /de/stay/: «Die erste Gruppe».

ix.listH.context: Index page /de/restaurants-cafes/: H2 of the restaurants section (10 restaurants). «hand-picked / مختارة» = selected for the list; the page elsewhere states it does NOT rank or recommend — keep «selected», not «best».

ix.cafesEyebrow.context: Index page /de/restaurants-cafes/: eyebrow above the cafés H2.

ix.cafesH.context: Index page /de/restaurants-cafes/: H2 of the cafés section. Parallel to ix.listH.

ix.bakeriesEyebrow.context: Index page /de/restaurants-cafes/: eyebrow above the bakeries H2. «tannour / التنّور» = termbase «der Tanur (Lehmofen)»; gloss rule: the gloss «(Lehmofen)» goes at the first occurrence in running text on the page, not in a heading/eyebrow — coordinate with ix.bakeriesNote («clay ovens»).

ix.bakeriesH.context: Index page /de/restaurants-cafes/: H2 of the bakeries section (4 bakeries). Published German synonym: „rotes Brot“ (see dishes d8 card on /de/food/).

ix.bakeriesNote.en: Red bread and date bread are one and the same — these are the bakeries whose clay ovens are fired for it.
ix.bakeriesNote.ar: الخبز الأحمر هو خبز التمر نفسه، اسمان لطبقٍ واحد — وهذه مخابزُ تُوقد فيها التنانير له.
ix.bakeriesNote.context: Index page /de/restaurants-cafes/: note under the bakeries H2. MUST name «Dattelbrot» (the documented name) together with «rotes Brot» (C5b). «clay ovens / التنانير» = Tanur (termbase).

ix.newWindow.en: (opens Google Maps in a new window)
ix.newWindow.context: Screen-reader-only text on a card that opens Google Maps. LOCKED (BINDING from de-stay, published on /de/stay/): reuse the published German string verbatim — see context.published_stay_de.

ix.moreLabel.context: Link text at the bottom of a card leading to the place’s own page (template adds the arrow →). Published sibling on /de/stay/: «Details zum Ort».

ix.hoursLabel.context: Summary label of a collapsible block on a card listing the weekly opening hours (from Google Maps).

ix.ratingLabel.context: Screen-reader label after the star rating number. LOCKED (BINDING from de-stay, published on /de/stay/): reuse the published German string verbatim — see context.published_stay_de.

ix.searchPh.context: Placeholder of the search box above the list (ends with an ellipsis …). «area» = the location line of a card (district/street), as in ix.districtLabel.

ix.searchLabel.context: aria-label of the search box (screen readers).

ix.kindAria.context: aria-label of the group of filter chips (All · Restaurants · Cafés · Bakeries). The chip «All» is the published list.all (neighbours).

ix.kindRestaurants.context: Filter chip, followed by a count in brackets, e.g. «Restaurants (10)».

ix.districtLabel.context: Label of the location dropdown filter (options are district/area names, e.g. «Al-Koot-Viertel», «Al-Mubarraz», «Al-Khaleej-Straße»). Arabic «الموقع» = location. Not «Bezirk» (would imply an administrative district).

ix.districtAll.context: First option of that dropdown (no filter). Quoted verbatim inside ix.emptyMsg — keep identical.

ix.openNow.context: Small live badge on a card, computed from the visitor’s clock and Google hours.

ix.closedNow.context: Same badge, closed state. Parallel to ix.openNow.

ix.openFilter.context: Toggle chip that filters to places open right now. Same source text as ix.openNow; may be identical in German.

ix.hoursNote.en: Hours come from Google Maps and can change — check the place’s link.
ix.hoursNote.ar: المواعيد من خرائط قوقل وقد تتغير — تحقّق من رابط المكان.
ix.hoursNote.context: Small note under the opening-hours list on a card. «the place’s link» = the card’s Google Maps link. Sie-form.

ix.countPrefix.context: Live result counter, rendered as ix.countPrefix + NUMBER + " " + ix.countSuffix, e.g. «Showing 12 of 29». Keep the trailing space.

ix.countSuffix.context: Second half of the counter; {n} = total number of places (29). Keep {n} literally, exactly once. The coordinator adds the leading space.

ix.emptyMsg.en: No matches — try a broader search or select “All areas”.
ix.emptyMsg.ar: لا نتائج مطابقة — جرّب توسيع البحث أو اختيار «كل المواقع».
ix.emptyMsg.context: Shown when the filters match nothing. Quotes ix.districtAll verbatim inside German quotation marks „…“.

ix.closedPerm.en: Permanently closed — according to Google Maps
ix.closedPerm.context: Warning line on a card. LOCKED (BINDING from de-stay, published on /de/stay/): reuse the published German string verbatim — see context.published_stay_de.

ix.closedTemp.en: Temporarily closed — according to Google Maps
ix.closedTemp.context: Warning line on a card. LOCKED (BINDING from de-stay, published on /de/stay/): reuse the published German string verbatim — see context.published_stay_de.

ix.srcNote.en: Ratings and opening hours from Google Maps — last updated {date}
ix.srcNote.ar: التقييمات وأوقات العمل من خرائط قوقل — آخر تحديث {date}
ix.srcNote.context: Small note under the restaurants H2, shown once Google data is loaded. {date} = month + year («September 2026») — keep {date} literally, exactly once. The published /de/stay/ note is «Bewertungen von Google Maps – zuletzt aktualisiert {date}» (ratings only); this one adds opening hours — extend it, keep the rest of the locked wording.
